verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless mode intended for control by external clients via its API. It also documents UNO acceptor strings for remote connections, and its SDK ships API docs and a Developers Guide, so it can be driven programmatically through a documented public API. Community reports of a painful macro/Python automation experience and missing JavaScript API docs for Calc are usability complaints, not concrete evidence that the API fails. missing for 10: evidence pack shows no API reference content or depth, no hands-on corroboration of successful UNO API automation, and developer experience is reported as poor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This special mode can be used when the application is controlled by external clients via the API.
Notifies LibreOffice software that upon the creation of "UNO Acceptor Threads", a "UNO Accept String" will be used.
it is possible to use the SDK to develop an extension, for which you can read the API docs and Developers Guide.
